methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This paper presents the design and simulation of an intelligent Energy Management System (EMS) developed to support Elmsdale Lumber’s transition to net-zero energy consumption.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: EMS/tool and energy-system design without an identifiable EnPI or EnB measurement or baseline model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The EMS was developed as a modular, Python-based control framework aligned with ISO 50001 standards [2].

stage1.notes: Solar forecasting and PV sizing support EMS control/design; neither is presented as an EnPI or EnB measurement/baseline model.
